themes.note: Night is :root. Day applies with data-theme=day, or when no theme is saved and the OS prefers light. Sticker fills and keylines do not change.

display.purpose: Hero headline, uppercase, stacked lines; close band runs to clamp(3.4rem, 10vw, 10rem).

headline.purpose: Section headings and the app list title.

title.purpose: Step and card titles, wordmark, big tabular numerals.

mono.purpose: Install command, terminal pane, Markdown proof only.

shadows.name: lift

shadows.name: lift-sm
shadows.purpose: Buttons and active list item at rest. Resolves at :root; redefine when --shadow changes.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Sticker Stack"**

A todo list is a stack of loud, physical stickers you slap down and tick off. Every object is a flat block of colour with a black keyline and a hard offset shadow, set slightly askew, sitting on a near-black ground. The world is user-pinned to two neobrutalist references (zagged.com and two7square.com); the hard shadows, keylines and tilt are its native materials, not decoration to be trimmed.

Night is the default ground. Day swaps the ground to cream and the shadows to black; it applies when the visitor picks it on the Day/Night toggle, or when no choice is saved and the OS prefers light. Stickers keep their fills and black keylines in both themes. Display type is giant condensed uppercase; body type is a sturdy grotesk; anything that is literally a command or Markdown is mono, shown in a dark terminal pane, because the terminal is the same list seen a second time.

The landing page (Persuade) carries the loud version: tilted stickers, a slap-in entrance, a lime close band. The app (Operate) keeps the same materials but holds still: rows are untilted, colour marks state, and the only motion is the checkbox wobble and the progress fill.

The product name is a working name and will change. It is set only in `web/src/lib/brand.ts` and rendered as live display type; no surface may bake it into a raster, a CSS `content` string, or copy outside that constant.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, cream ink, whole-block accent fills.
2.5px black keyline on every sticker, chip and checkbox.
Hard offset shadows with zero blur, cream on Night and black on Day.
Small tilts (about -2deg to +1.5deg) on Persuade objects; none on Operate rows.
Condensed uppercase display at poster scale against a plain grotesk body.

rules.name: The Lime Means Done Rule
rules.body: Lime marks completion, the current list, and the primary action. Do not spend it on decoration that has no state.

rules.name: The Day Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Lime text only works on Night. On Day the same emphasis becomes a lime marker block behind ink-coloured text, cloned across line breaks.

rules.name: The Hot Is Trouble Rule
rules.body: Hot pink appears only for delete, late, invalid and error.

rules.name: The All-Caps Display Rule
rules.body: Display type is always uppercase, 900, line-height 0.86, tracking -0.01em. Body and labels are never uppercase.

rules.name: The Mono Is Literal Rule
rules.body: Mono is for text a user could paste into a terminal or find in their Markdown file, nothing else.

rules.name: The Overlap Rule
rules.body: Stickers may overlap each other (the hero terminal pane tucks under the demo card), but text never sits on top of another sticker's text.

rules.name: The Press-Down Rule
rules.body: Buttons rise slightly on hover and press flat into their shadow on click.

rules.name: The Lift Redefinition Rule
rules.body: `--lift` and `--lift-sm` resolve at `:root`. Any section that changes `--shadow` (such as the lime close band setting it to black) must redefine `--lift` and `--lift-sm` too, or its buttons keep the root shadow colour.

rules.name: The Square Sticker Rule
rules.body: If it has a keyline, it has square corners.

rules.name: The Still App Rule
rules.body: Tilt belongs to the landing page. In the app, rows, fields and panels stay straight; only a checkbox wobbles (-6deg) on hover.

dos: Do give every sticker, chip and checkbox a black keyline (2.5px on stickers) and square corners.
Do use hard offset shadows with zero blur, cream on Night and black on Day.
Do redefine `--lift` and `--lift-sm` wherever a section changes `--shadow`.
Do turn lime emphasis text into a lime marker block behind ink text on Day.
Do read the product name from `web/src/lib/brand.ts` and render it as live text.
Do keep text on sticker fills black, whatever the fill.
donts: Don't round corners on stickers, buttons, chips, fields or panels.
Don't use blurred or ambient shadows, or gradients as depth.
Don't set lime text on the Day ground.
Don't tilt rows, fields or panels in the app.
Don't use hot pink for anything but delete, late, invalid and error.
Don't hardcode the product name in copy, CSS or images.
